scope: Read-only narrow static review of Guard owner validation/capture/restore, native Driver reconstruction, and exact Guard value equality. No Codec/reward/full-project review.
assessment: One confirmed native-ground projection defect was reported and corrected in the candidate; no remaining confirmed issue in this limited scope. UE execution remains unverified by this reviewer.

facts: Pure PointValid admits every finite nonnegative Z: ActualSource/DungeonStoneGuard.cpp:14.
Pure saved validation requires Position.Z==InitialPosition.Z but does not require zero: ActualSource/DungeonStoneGuard.cpp:283-284.
Original owner projection required native JumpHeight/JumpVelocity zero while checking only kernel XY.
Native Driver QuerySweep rejects nonzero query From.Z or To.Z: candidate-source/DungeonStoneGuardDriver.cpp:176-180.
resolved_findings.inference: A lawful pure nonzero-Z state could be reconstructed using its saved birth and pass the old owner projection with a zero native JumpHeight, leaving native body/display inconsistent with kernel height.
resolved_findings.risk: The accepted snapshot could later reject native movement or use a different kernel combat height from the restored ground actor.
resolved_findings.confirmed_correction: candidate-source/DungeonFighter.cpp:336 now rejects G.InitialPosition.Z!=0.||G.Position.Z!=0.; native zero JumpHeight/JumpVelocity constraints remain at337.
resolved_findings.runtime_reproduction: Not executed; finding and correction verified by direct static predicate tracing. Frozen UE groups were not modified.

checked_invariants: Guard kind requires owner Schema3 and exactly the Guard optional; legacy Player/Knight/Bat owner Schema2 remains distinct.
Stable current003 identity/content and saved aggregate equipment/world context are validated before publishing any owner changes.
Pure validation and temporary native Driver both reconstruct saved immutable birth and explicit saved Policy; Driver Restore delegates to the existing same-birth pure Restore.
No Step/Sync/BeginCombat/world query occurs in the newly added Guard Restore path.
Guard capture checks LastGuardSyncTime==Kernel.Time and copies actual native DeathObserved separately from local Kernel.RewardClaimed and formal DeathReported.
Guard observer and driver publication occur only after candidate validation; failed validation returns before mutation.
Formal Guard DeathReported remains rejected; local RewardClaimed is retained without being converted into settlement.
Exact value helper compares every FState member, every nested wire value member, explicit Policy, observer, wrapper Schema, optional presence, and ordered history values.
Per-double comparison uses IEEE representation bytes; padded aggregate structs are never memcmp compared.
limitations: No actual Owner/Driver UE execution, UBT, staged installation, or target automation performed.
Static member-reference coverage supplements direct source review; it is not runtime proof.
No claim about Codec, reward admission, disk continuation, full-room settlement, or full project correctness.
